_about: M1: Narrative's player-style labels, revision 2 (docs/narrative/style-thresholds.md, signed off by Game Design), loaded by sim/core/mood.gd. Percentages are integers, compared by cross-multiplication (100 x part > pct x whole) on the rolling window. Times are seconds at the 1 Hz evaluation. The measure strings are closed keys the code implements, not formulas it parses. An attack is an exchange the fighter's director started, counted by its weight at the start. minHeldS: a label cannot end or be replaced until held this long. The mixer's leaveMaxStancePct and leaveHoldS make its leaveWhen text a number.

mixer.definition: no dominant stance and a spread of attack kinds
mixer.leaveWhen: any other label enters, or the largest stance share exceeds 58 percent for 10 s

judgedOnAI.shortestLabelHeldS: at least 12 (guaranteed by minHeldS except at the end of a match)

judgedOnHumanOrScriptedPlay.everyLabelReached: scripted style bots (a turtler, a charger, a runner, a sniper) and playtests, not AI against AI
judgedOnHumanOrScriptedPlay.labelShares: a description of behaviour, not a target; report but do not band
